description: This file is a test script for the 'bundle-uri' command within a version control system (like git). It sets up various test scenarios to verify the behavior of protocol v2 interactions, specifically related to bundle URIs over different protocols (file, git, http). It includes setup routines, conditional logic based on protocol type, and assertions to check server responses and command outputs.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisites for the test based on the protocol.

methods.name: start_git_daemon
methods.description: Starts a git daemon for testing purposes.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_tool bundle-uri
methods.description: Runs the 'bundle-uri' testing tool with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_cmp_config_output
methods.description: Compares expected configuration output with actual.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Schedules cleanup commands after test completion.
